answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. What survives to the cipher is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the saffron of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the forge re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
